title: River Habitat Assessment (RHA)
description: Stream reach habitat quality assessment. Ten scored parameters (1-10 each) summing to a total habitat score out of 100, matching the official RHA Field Recording Sheet.

fields.label: 2. Invertebrate habitat diversity
fields.hint: Number of different substrate types (boulders, cobbles, gravel, sand, wood, leaves, root mats, macrophytes, periphyton). Presence of interstitial space scores higher. ≥5 types=10, down to 1 type=1

fields.label: 3. Invertebrate habitat abundance
fields.hint: % of substrate favourable for EPT colonisation (flowing water over gravel/cobbles clear of filamentous algae/macrophytes). 95%=10, 75%=9, 70%=8, 60%=7, 50%=6, 40%=5, 30%=4, 25%=3, 15%=2, 5%=1

fields.label: 4. Fish cover diversity
fields.hint: Number of different substrate types (woody debris, root mats, undercut banks, overhanging/encroaching vegetation, macrophytes, boulders, cobbles). Spatial complexity scores higher. ≥5 types=10, down to 1 type=1

fields.label: 6. Hydraulic heterogeneity
fields.hint: Number of hydraulic components (pool, riffle, fast run, slow run, rapid, cascade/waterfall, turbulence, backwater). Presence of deep pools scores higher. ≥5=10, down to 1=1

fields.label: 7. Bank erosion — left bank
fields.hint: % of left bank recently/actively eroding (scouring at waterline, slumping, stock pugging)

fields.label: 8. Bank vegetation — category
options: Mature native trees with diverse and intact understorey
Regenerating native, or flaxes/sedges/tussock > dense exotic
Mature shrubs, sparse tree cover > young exotic, long grass
Heavily grazed or mown grass > bare/impervious ground

fields.label: 8. Bank vegetation — score
fields.hint: Maturity, diversity and naturalness of bank vegetation, both banks

fields.label: 9. Riparian width — left bank
fields.hint: Width (m) of riparian buffer constrained by vegetation, fence, or other structure(s)

fields.label: 9. Riparian width — right bank
fields.hint: Width (m) of riparian buffer, right bank

fields.label: 10. Riparian shade
fields.hint: % shading of the streambed throughout the day due to vegetation, banks, or other structure(s). ≥90%=10, 80%=9, 70%=8, 60%=7, 50%=6, 40%=5, 25%=4, 15%=3, 10%=2, ≤5%=1
